name: city-hall-0
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP, cm = a.controllerManager; const g = (x, z) => Math.max(cm.getGroundHeight(x, z, 'person') || 0, 0); a.selectMode('cyclist'); a.selectCamera('chase', true); a.teleportTo(-13.0, -720.0, 0); const y0 = g(-13.0, -720.0), y1 = g(-13, -900); a.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-13.0, y0 + 30, -720.0], look: [-13, y1 + 8, -900], fov: 50 }); })()
